data.long_meaning: Ivanthansh is a combination of the names 'Ivan' and 'Thansh'. Ivan is a popular Hindu name meaning 'God'. Thansh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Thanshana', which means 'wisdom'. Thus, Ivanthansh represents the god of wisdom and power. The name Ivanthansh carries the meaning “God of Wisdom and Power” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Ivanthansh usually hope their child will grow to embody god of wisdom and power and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Ivanthansh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Wisdom and Power.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ivanthansh total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
